source_metadata.title: Pharmacokinetic Study of Cefazolin in Short Daily Hemodialysis

consistency_findings.handling: Both directly reported values were retained as separate atoms with distinct anchors.

extraction_limitations: The source reports total cefazolin concentrations rather than measured unbound concentrations.
Five of ten dialysate sample sets were lost because of laboratory error; dialysate-recovery atoms are anchored to n=5.

The current LiteratureAtom schema cannot encode every multi-timepoint concentration profile or model equation without splitting; representative independently reviewable assertions were atomized while methods and figures remain available in the SEA artifact.
